audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0, 1, 3 and 4 disagree with the published mirror.
audit.why: The mirror audit (illaoi__warwick) set L1 Warwick, L2 skill, L3 and Levels 4-5 Illaoi, Level 6 Warwick, first item and 2+ items Illaoi, and notes the chart had disagreed with the packet on four of seven rows before its repair. This side's packet agrees on rows 0, 1, 4 and 6.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 3 and 4 flipped on both layers as one atomic group, ratings rescaled, and whys[2], whys[3], whys[5] rewritten to agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns or ranges anywhere; Level 6 was generic boilerplate.
audit.why: Test of Spirit is 16/15/14/13/12s from 900 range against a 365-range Jaws of the Beast — that range gap is why she picks every fight. Harsh Lesson is a 4-second leap that makes nearby Tentacles swing at the target, so it is her real mobility, not her ultimate. Primal Howl is 15s at rank 1 for 2.5s of damage reduction into a 1s fear.
audit.corrected: The 900-vs-365 picture and the 16s / 4s / 15s timers are now in phases[3].why, phases[4].why, breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.mid, mid, spikes[1] and dosFull[0].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] and wants.you[1] say to ult her 'the instant she casts Leap of Faith' so she 'can't kite between her spawned tentacles'. Primal Howl is absent from the entire page.
audit.why: Leap of Faith grants Illaoi no mobility in Riot's text — it deals damage and spawns a Tentacle per champion hit. Her leap is Harsh Lesson, a 4-second cooldown. Meanwhile Primal Howl is the ability that actually decides whether you survive her field: 2.5s of damage reduction, then a 1s fear, on 15s. The mirror agent reports it was missing from Illaoi's page too, calling it the ability that most often saves Warwick inside the tentacles.
audit.corrected: Harsh Lesson named as her mobility, the false Leap-of-Faith kite claim removed, and Primal Howl written into spikes[1], mid, phases[4].why, breakdown.cooldowns, tradeBad and wants.you[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: The kit file's derived flags put grounding and untargetable on Leap of Faith.
audit.why: Riot's description for Leap of Faith contains neither — it says she smashes her idol into the ground for physical damage and spawns a Tentacle per champion hit. The word 'ground' almost certainly tripped the tooltip parser. Grounding would matter enormously here, since Jaws of the Beast and Infinite Duress are both flagged as dashes, but I will not assert it from a flag that contradicts the description.
audit.corrected: No text written either way. Recorded in unverified.

audit.whatIsWrong: Illaoi is referred to as 'he'/'his' in tradeGood, dosFull[1].d, breakdown.trading, report[3], breakdown.mid, breakdown.feeding, report[12], breakdown.late and report[8].
audit.why: Illaoi is female; nine pronoun errors on one page.
audit.corrected: Corrected in the same edits carrying the mechanical fixes.
